I inspected the rendered views and the reference photos to address the weakest feature, "Window and door lines," which scored a mean of 2.57/10.

The original code only placed windows and doors on one side of the aircraft (positive Z). I have updated the `windowGroup` loop to iterate through both sides (`[1, -1].forEach(side => ...)`), populating symmetrical window lines for the main deck and the upper-deck hump. I also expanded this symmetry to the cargo/passenger doors. This change targets the 10 anchor of creating a clean, consistent window line across both visible sides of the aircraft without regressing the established fuselage or wing geometry.
